message.reasoning_content: Yellow Submarine album—only Yellow Submarine and Hey Bulldog are new; Hey Bulldog appeared first on that album, as did Yellow Submarine. Both? Question: "which of these songs did it include before any other album did" — Hey Bulldog debuted there; Yellow Submarine was also first there. But Yellow Submarine single released 1966 before album... the song itself—album includes it. Hmm, ambiguity: Yellow Submarine appeared on Revolver too. Actually Yellow Submarine (song) is on Revolver. So answer: Hey Bulldog.
